**tuna-fonts 0.4.0**: get to know your fonts. Filter by OpenType features, see who made a font and under what license, and take your library to another PC. If you have 0.3.x or older, the app will offer it when you open it.

### New
- **Filter by OpenType features.** A new group in the sidebar lists what your fonts can do: small caps, oldstyle figures, tabular figures, ligatures, swashes, stylistic sets and fractions. Click one to see only the fonts that have it, and combine it with a category. Thanks to the Reddit user who asked for true small caps and oldstyle figures!
- **Information in each font's page**: designer, foundry, version, website, license and copyright, straight from the font file, plus the name it shows up as in your apps.
- **OpenType features in each font's page**, with live examples: small caps, oldstyle figures, discretionary ligatures, swashes and fractions.
- **Export and import your library.** Settings → *Copy of your library*: favorites and collections in one file, to take them to another PC or keep a backup. Importing never deletes anything; collections with the same name are merged.

### Fixed
- Switching between light and dark theme no longer flashes the selectors black or white for a moment.

The first time you open 0.4.0, it reads your fonts again to find their features, so the list may take a little longer to appear once.

### Downloads
- **`tuna-fonts_0.4.0_x64-setup.exe`**: installer (per user, no admin rights needed). Updates itself.
- **`tuna-fonts_0.4.0_x64-portable.zip`**: portable version; unzip and run `tuna-fonts.exe`.

Windows 10/11, 64-bit. **Not code-signed**, so Windows SmartScreen may warn you the first time: *More info → Run anyway*.

Found a bug? [Open an issue](https://github.com/atunfrito/tuna-fonts/issues/new/choose).

---

**En español:** la 0.4.0 te deja conocer mejor tus fuentes. Hay un grupo nuevo en la barra lateral para filtrar por funciones OpenType (versalitas, números antiguos, números tabulares, ligaduras, florituras, conjuntos estilísticos y fracciones), combinable con las categorías. La ficha de cada fuente dice quién la diseñó, el fabricante, la versión, la web, la licencia y el copyright, con qué nombre sale en tus programas y qué funciones OpenType trae, con ejemplos. En Ajustes → *Copia de tu biblioteca* puedes exportar e importar tus favoritas y colecciones para llevarlas a otro PC. Además, al cambiar de tema los selectores ya no se ven un momento negros o blancos. La primera vez que la abras volverá a leer tus fuentes, así que puede tardar un poco más en salir la lista.
